Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this NIELIT recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Data Entry Operator- D. This is a contract-based position within the National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator- D post?
faq.answer: As per the provided data, there are 0 vacancies announced for the Data Entry Operator- D position. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for any updates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this NIELIT recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time without any prior online application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator- D post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Data Entry Operator- D post will receive a salary of Rs. 29200 Per Month. This is a contract-based role.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications required for the Data Entry Operator- D post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a Graduation degree from a recognized University and a typing speed of not less than 35 words per minute in English. A diploma in computer applications is desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the walk-in date for the NIELIT Data Entry Operator- D recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Data Entry Operator- D post is scheduled to be held on 24 September 2026. Candidates should report at the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue located?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted in New Delhi, Delhi, with the pincode 110058. The exact venue details will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Data Entry Operator- D role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, a Typing Test, and an Interaction/Interview. Candidates must clear each stage to be considered for the position.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an application fee for this NIELIT recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, there is an application fee. General/OBC candidates need to pay Rs. 750/-, and SC/ST candidates also need to pay Rs. 750/-.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of NIELIT?
faq.answer: The official website of the National Institute of Electronics and Information Technology (NIELIT) is https://www.nielit.gov.in/NielitMain/DEL. Candidates can visit this site for more information.
